title: Live call transcription line: every word posted to a server you own, with no model in the call path
summary: A transcription line demo built to show live_transcribe sending every utterance to your own authenticated webhook. The SWML has no ai verb, viewers get a read-only login, and the payload adapter is the one place that knows the event shape.
scenario: A caller dials in and talks; each utterance is posted to your endpoint, stored per call and re-broadcast over Server-Sent Events
